title: A bool encoded as 2 decodes as false, while stellar-core reads the same bytes as true

target.versions_affected: 28.0.0 - 30.0.0 (28.0.0, 28.0.1 and 30.0.0 executed; lower bound not established)

severity_basis: Acceptance of invalid input with the opposite value to stellar-core's reading of the same bytes (core's xdrpp reads any non-zero bool as TRUE; print-xdr executed). Core re-serialises canonically, so ledger data never carries the value; a tool that decodes a submitted envelope before core would show false where core applies true. No such tool is verified. Under both decode profiles.
caps_note: No CAP applies: an XDR encoding rule that holds in every protocol version (the corpus's xdr-strict group).

entries.expected: reject: an XDR bool is 0 or 1 (RFC 4506 4.4)
entries.observed: Executed on 28.0.0, 28.0.1 and 30.0.0 under limits-default and limits-none: decodes as ScVal::Bool(false) and re-encodes as 0000000000000000.

evidence.pre_fix: Conformance runner (make verify-conformance; xcc conform run --columns 'rust@*' --entries 'xdr-strict/bool-value-2'), L0, on every Rust column: verdict diverge (reencode_mismatch).
evidence.expected_basis: RFC 4506 4.4 (a bool is 0 or 1); stellar-core 30.0.0 print-xdr reads the same bytes as TRUE (evidence/core-print-xdr/out/bool-2.txt).

reproduction.method: Independent re-run, separate from the first: rust@28.0.0, 28.0.1 and 30.0.0 under limits-default and limits-none decode the bool 2 as false and re-encode 0; core@30.0.0 reads it as true. Confirmed again on 30.0.0 and main ebec5fb before filing.

approval.scope: Public issue on stellar/rs-stellar-xdr (#622): bool 2 and 0xffffffff decode as false and re-encode as 0, while stellar-core reads true.

history.note: Created from the conformance cells of xdr-strict/bool-value-2 on the Rust columns; no public issue or pull request found (an unmerged upstream branch carries a fix commit, c3fdc2e9, with no pull request).

Filed by the maintainers of this kit as https://github.com/stellar/rs-stellar-xdr/issues/622, against 30.0.0 and main ebec5fb; cites xdrpp from_uint (u != 0) and the maintainer's unmerged branches reject-invalid-xdr-bool (e7416c43) and fix-bool-and-whitespace-decode (c3fdc2e9). No pull request.
